DACI Level 3

Advanced Crisis Intervention, Subject Control & Restraint

Advanced crisis communication, assessment, and instructor-supervised subject control and restraint training for law enforcement and corrections personnel.

← All DACI programs
Law Enforcement & Corrections Only

Who this program is for

Law enforcement officers and corrections or detention personnel only.

Restricted to law enforcement and corrections. This program is not offered as a general healthcare, school, retail, or private-security pathway.

Learning outcomes

  • Recognize escalation and assess changing threats.
  • Apply de-escalation and agency-approved decision-making principles.
  • Coordinate a response within agency policy and authorized duties.
  • Recognize medical distress and complete post-incident responsibilities.
Plan your training

Format & completion

24-hour basic certification

Basic certification: 24 hours; advanced certification: 40 hours; instructor certification: 80 hours. Eligibility and agency requirements are reviewed before scheduling.

Written examination, instructor-supervised skills assessment, scenario evaluation, and team performance assessment.

Inside the program

Curriculum & Learning Modules

A practical overview of the topics covered in this DACI program.

MODULE 01

Behavioral crisis recognition

Recognize crisis indicators and factors influencing behavior.

MODULE 02

Advanced de-escalation

Practice communication, active listening, and techniques for reducing confrontation.

MODULE 03

Legal considerations & agency policy

Review decision-making responsibilities within applicable law and agency policy.

MODULE 04

Threat assessment & officer safety

Assess environmental risk and maintain situational awareness.

MODULE 05

Team-based crisis intervention

Coordinate roles, communication, and a planned response.

MODULE 06

Subject control & restraint principles

Study and practice authorized skills with an instructor.

MODULE 07

High-risk crisis encounters

Use supervised scenarios to consider complex operational situations.

MODULE 08

Medical considerations

Recognize distress, monitor safety, and seek medical support.

MODULE 09

Post-incident responsibilities

Complete reporting, documentation, review, and staff support.

MODULE 10

Scenario-based evaluation

Demonstrate communication, assessment, and coordinated team performance.
